title: Vectors: EUI-64 to IID test cases
description:
RE-SCOPED (2026-08-25): EUI-64-to-IID derivation is a TOTAL function over fixed-width inputs; language-neutral JSON cannot encode a rejectable input class for it, so coverage = positive vectors + inline rejection unit tests.

Oracle analysis:
- python/src/lichen/ipv6/addr.py eui64_to_iid(): XOR with U/L bit, total over all 2^64 8-byte inputs. The ONLY runtime reject is wrong byte-width (len != 8 -> AddrError), an API-binding artifact: Rust/C implementations take fixed [u8; 8] where a 7-byte EUI-64 is unconstructible, so an expect-error vector would validate nothing cross-language.
- No reserved-pattern reject class exists: code performs no multicast-bit/reserved checks (vector eui64_all_ff with U/L=0xff -> 0xfd including multicast bit set is accepted BY DESIGN), and repo spec grep for reserved/reject/MUST-NOT rules on EUI/IID derivation returned nothing.
- Contrast: wire PARSERS have real reject classes (see schema ipv6_malformed_vector / ipv6_malformed.json); typed host-side derivations do not. Same judgment as sibling l1qw.9.7.5 (closed 2026-08-25T17:53Z).

Real coverage:
- Positive vectors ALREADY in oracle file test/vectors/ipv6-addresses.json profile=link_interoperability_only: eui64_spec_example (U/L clear->set, matches spec 12.2 worked example), eui64_zero (0x00->0x02 boundary), eui64_all_ff (0xff->0xfd boundary).
- Inline rejection tests in consumer python/tests/ipv6/test_addr.py: test_eui64_to_iid_rejects_wrong_length (7-byte input), test_mac48_to_eui64_rejects_wrong_length (5-byte input), test_short_addr_to_iid_rejects_out_of_range (0x10000); plus test_mac48_to_iid_full_chain end-to-end modified-EUI-64 check.

Gates run 2026-08-25:
cd python && uv run --extra dev pytest tests/ipv6/test_addr.py -q => 16 passed
cd python && uv run --extra dev pytest tests/ipv6 tests/test_vectors.py -q => 732 passed
close_reason: Re-scoped: EUI-64->IID is total over fixed-width 8-byte inputs; only reject class is wrong byte-width (binding artifact, unconstructible in fixed-width C/Rust), already covered by inline tests test_eui64_to_iid_rejects_wrong_length / test_mac48_to_eui64_rejects_wrong_length in python/tests/ipv6/test_addr.py. Positive boundary vectors already exist in ipv6-addresses.json (eui64_spec_example, eui64_zero, eui64_all_ff). Gates green 2026-08-25: pytest tests/ipv6/test_addr.py -q = 16 passed; pytest tests/ipv6 tests/test_vectors.py -q = 732 passed. No vectors faked.
